}}'''Nels Bulson''' was an officer of the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] who worked on the investigation into [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Havriso Looruya]] of [[Yir Tangee/Legends|Yir Tangee]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. After receiving evidence from [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] linking Senator Looruya to several large credit transactions to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] territories on [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], and [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], Officer Bulson issued a statement to [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] about the investigation.<ref name="HNN54" />
